for a techie, i tweet & RT a lot about social justice issues.
especially issues related to racism, #BlackLivesMatter
and First Nations/Indigenous/Native sovereignty.

@juliestcyr i've seen similar statements in exchanges regarding #blacklivesmatter, the rights of indigenous peoples & tribes, and feminist issues.
often in proximity to a haughty "you just lost an ally" proclamation.

@PCutlerUT @deray yeah... looks a bit like an "i don't see color" or "all lives matter" response to #blacklivesmatter At the least, its fuel for those that'd light those tiki torches...
